scope: Static, read-only audit of the aerodynamic path that actually produces the archived P2 drag/fuel-burn numbers, plus the capabilities and limits of the candidate VSPAERO and SU2 paths. No new physical computation was performed for this audit.

chain: base_analysis appends RCAIDE Aerodynamics.Vortex_Lattice_Method() (Concorde.py:886) and sets aerodynamics.vortex_lift = True (line 887); main wing also sets wing.vortex_lift = True (line 261)

research/concorde_metaopt/evaluation/low_fidelity.py::SingleCruiseBackend.evaluate -> build_vehicle -> evaluation/mission.py::build_single_cruise_mission -> RCAIDE Sequential_Segments with one Constant_Mach_Constant_Altitude cruise segment
segment.analyses contains the tutorial analyses; Vortex_Lattice_Method.evaluate(state, settings, vehicle) computes the aerodynamic state each iteration

RCAIDE Vortex_Lattice_Method.initialize -> use_surrogate == True by default -> train_VLM_surrogates + build_VLM_surrogates -> evaluate_surrogate for every solve (Aerodynamics.py:67 use_surrogate=True, not overridden by the tutorial)
activated_path.method_class_docstring: Vortex_Lattice_Method.py class docstring line 25: 'This is a subsonic aerodynamic buildup analysis based on the vortex lattice method' (the implementation nevertheless contains supersonic kernels; see vlm_capability)

supersonic_kernel_evidence: VLM.py:248 B2 = np.tile((mach**2 - 1), VD.n_cp[0]) — supersonic kernel uses beta^2 = M^2 - 1
VLM.py:217-218 RHS = RHS*RFLAG with comment 'Turn off sonic vortices when Mach>1'
VLM.py:371-374 vortex lift is multiplied by (mach<1), i.e. vortex lift is disabled above Mach 1
VLM.py:585-624 induced-drag docstring: 'Incompressible, inviscid flow (Trefftz-plane analysis is exact only in this limit; compressibility corrections are applied elsewhere)'
vlm_capability.unresolved_question: Whether a VORLAX-derived supersonic VLM is quantitatively credible for this 12D lifting-surface configuration near Mach 2.02 with a 30x15 lattice, and whether the Trefftz-plane induced-drag formula is consistent with the supersonic lift representation. B-P3-VLM-MACH2 (audit.py:679) remains open. No Mach-sweep validation of the VLM itself exists.
vlm_capability.verdict: LF outputs may be used as an algorithmic low-fidelity objective (as P2 already did), but must not be presented as physically validated supersonic aerodynamics. Gate LF-M2.02 cannot pass on the current evidence.

surrogate_path.why: RCAIDE Aerodynamics.py line 67 sets use_surrogate=True by default and the tutorial never overrides it; exotic_engine / configs_setup do not touch it.
behavior: Vortex_Lattice_Method.initialize (lines 150-178): trains surrogates over the training grid, then compute.lift.inviscid_wings = evaluate_surrogate (or evaluate_no_surrogate if disabled)
training defaults (Vortex_Lattice_Method.py:80-106): 11 Mach nodes [0.1,0.3,0.5,0.65,0.85,0.9,1.3,1.5,2.0,2.5,3.5]; 7 AoA nodes [-2, ~0, 2, 5, 8, 12, 45] deg; sideslip [10,5] deg

build_VLM_surrogates.py: always builds subsonic surrogate; builds transonic+supersonic surrogates only if len(sup_Mach) > 2; uses scipy RegularGridInterpolator(method='linear', bounds_error=False, fill_value=None) and interp1d(kind='linear', fill_value='extrapolate')
cruise Mach 2.02 lies between the 2.0 and 2.5 nodes -> interpolation for Mach, but the AoA solution may fall outside the training AoA grid, in which case the interpolator extrapolates
evaluate_surrogate blends sub/trans/sup with Cubic_Spline_Blender: subsonic 0.85-0.95, supersonic 1.05-1.15 smoothing windows
surrogate_path.drag_coverage: evaluate_VLM.py:27 docstring: 'Drag due to angle of attack is the dominant drag component and the only one calculated' by the surrogate itself; the remaining parasite/compressibility/misc/form/trim terms are added by process.compute after the lift surrogate call.
caveats: The surrogate is retrained per design because geometry changes invalidate the panel solution; this is why each P2 evaluation costs ~80-101 s wall.
Mach 2.02 is interpolated, not extrapolated (good), but that says nothing about physical fidelity of the underlying VLM training samples.
No archived run exercises evaluate_no_surrogate; the raw VLM path has never been compared against the surrogate path in this repo.

drag_decomposition.total_formula: RCAIDE total_drag.py:86-102: drag.total = settings.trim_drag_correction_factor * (parasite_total + induced_total + compressibility_total + miscellaneous + cooling + trim + form + drag_coefficient_increment)

components.name: parasite_total
components.source: parasite_drag_wing/fuselage/nacelle/pylon per component; parasitic_total sums them
components.includes: skin friction, form factor, compressibility factor, Reynolds factor; wetted-area based

components.name: induced
components.includes: lift-induced drag only, incompressible Trefftz formula

components.name: compressibility
components.source: compressibility_drag.py: subsonic Shevell (AA241) + transonic Lock 1986 lift wave drag (Mach<=1 only) + supersonic JAXA lift wave drag (main wing only) + Wright Lab supersonic volume wave drag
components.includes: wave drag split into lift and volume parts; writes compressible.total/wave.total/wave.volume/wave.lift to conditions

drag_decomposition.lift_side: lift.fuselage = fuselage_lift_correction (factor 1.20, fixed while the fuselage is fixed) and lift.inviscid_wings from VLM/surrogate; the VLM uses Sref = geometry.reference_area (358.25 m2) and sums wing strip forces.

known_method_risks.risk: Supersonic VLM applicability for the 12D wing is unvalidated (class docstring says subsonic).

The surrogate adds AoA-induced drag only; other terms are added by empirical build-up methods, so a drag increment can come from a different method family than the lift it is paired with. No component-level N-force ledger is written by the archived runs.

Potential double counting between VLM Trefftz induced drag and the JAXA supersonic lift wave drag (both scale with CL^2); RCAIDE declares additivity with no overlap, but this has not been demonstrated for this configuration.

The wave-drag volume term uses maximum cross-sectional area / length and cannot represent a lifting-surface-only body correction; the fuselage-fixed assumption therefore does not remove the body-drag problem.
Mach 2.02 is interpolated between training nodes 2.0 and 2.5; within training bounds but unvalidated between nodes.
Wing wetted area is set to the reference area (358.25 m2) and wing-body occlusion G10 is not modelled; body/parasite area attribution is therefore uncertain (upstream exposed area 326.5 m2).

evaluation/high_fidelity.py is a fail-closed NotImplementedError stub; no SU2 case exists in this repo, and rcaide-multifidelity 0.1.0 evidence is Euler-only with a limited native input scope (B-P3-HF-SCOPE).
No closed external-flow mesh generator exists in the repo that can wrap a real 12D wing/vertical-tail thick surface; Gmsh is CLI-only, no Python module in the project interpreter (B-P3-GMSH-BINDING).

vspaero_assessment.verdict: VSPAERO is a credible LF-surface-validation candidate, but its installation success, VSP3/STL generation and prior P1 OpenVSP checks are NOT aerodynamic PASS evidence. Gate LF-M2.02 requires an actual Mach 2.02 VSPAERO solve matrix with reference-area bookkeeping.

su2_assessment.installed: SU2 v8.5.0 Harrier win64-mpi at D:/Program Files/SU2/SU2-v8.5.0-win64-mpi/win64-mpi/bin/SU2_CFD.exe (not on PATH)
su2_assessment.official_reference: SU2 inviscid wedge tutorial is widely used as a Mach-2 shock-angle verification case; only external documentation, not run here
su2_assessment.physics_limit: Euler equations are inviscid: no skin friction, no viscous separation, no viscous wave drag. A SU2 Euler result can support pressure-drag/wave-drag and shock-position checks, but cannot be called a full-aircraft high-fidelity fuel-burn model without an audited viscous correction or RANS evidence.
su2_assessment.readiness: NOT_IMPLEMENTED_FOR_CONCORDE: no mesh generator, no case template, no convergence script, no wing-only surface source pipeline in the repo.

body_correction_assessment.requirement: D_total(x) = D_lifting_surfaces(x) + D_body_and_interference_correction(x) + D_other(x) is only a STRUCTURE to be validated. It is not an approved model.
body_correction_assessment.current_status: The archived RCAIDE build-up already contains fuselage parasite, fuselage lift correction (1.20) and supersonic volume wave drag. There is no separable, traceable body/interference correction that can be removed from the lift-surface term and re-attributed to the fixed fuselage.
body_correction_assessment.fixed_fuselage_does_not_simplify_the_cor: The fuselage is fixed but the wing pressure field, wave system and wing-root juncture all change with the 12D variables, so wing-body interference is NOT constant. A constant correction factor is rejected by the Issue #4 contract.
body_correction_assessment.verdict: BODY-CORR: BLOCKED / NOT_VALIDATED. No correction model, no calibration data, no double-counting proof.
